title: Nepal-Tibet floods: 750 dead, 20,000 deployed as rising rivers hamper rescue ops
summary_full: Nepal and Tibet floods have claimed 750 lives and left over 3,000 missing.  Rescuers continue operations amid warnings of fresh flooding and difficult conditions.  Hundreds are believed trapped in hydropower tunnels, requiring specialized international assistance.  India and China are providing crucial support including forensic experts and relief supplies.  Infrastructure damage has cut off communities, while aid efforts are ongoing.
